snippet.title: Deep Fog Signals - Story Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Deep Fog Signals is a short atmospheric 2D horror puzzle adventure in which you use limited bandwidth to coordinate unstable crewmates, conduct esoteric research that could change the world, and interpret strange signals from the deep.

📻 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4100900/Deep_Fog_Signals/
